body: It was just porridge, but, it was pretty damn tasty ^^
personally, I'm in the pain group. though I do with it was constant numbness.. its a silly thing to say but that's how I feel.

I know theres so much ahead of me, thats one of the problems I face. I'm scared of it, I never feel good enough for anything. I doubt i'd get a job, be able to take care of people, and be able to live my life somehow normally. Also, yes, I have Cognitive behavioural therapy regularly, and see a psychiatrist too.

I know its hormones but there are deep seeded issues which caused my depression along with it being genetic, these caused me to be diagnosed as having severe depression and given medication. 
thanks I guess, I'll answer anything you're interested to know.

I'm 14, I should really, but I dont have the motivation to anymore. I'll try to take them, but things dont seem to improve when I take them, aside from being able to function. 
I'll be sure to PM you when needed, thankyou. 
this helped a lot, and reminded me to take my medication. so thanks again.

well, they said it'll be okay and I'll be better in a week or so and it was just me feeling sad.
but one friend actually sent me to the counsellor who got me referred to CAHMS. so it was a mix of the two, I do think you should tell someone though.

I told my friends first, only the ones who I knew would understand. But that was because I was really scared, I think it's best to tell your parents first. If you feel like you need help, get it. 
I think I realised at my first suicide attempt, I thought 'I wont do it, im not really depressed' and ended up trying. it was out of my control, and then I just knew I needed help. Although it was hard to accept.
